digest.component_or_area: tracker path derivation and config root composition
propositions: Config-root derivation via dirname(str(tracker)) in three advisory-only sites (composer.py:274/286, composer_edit.py:141) silently suppresses description-cap and duplicate warnings on relocated stores by reading an empty config instead of the code repo config

The str()-wrapped store path variant dirname(str(tracker)) is not caught by the existing check_repo_root_from_tracker.py guard, which only flags bare dirname(tracker) forms, leaving these sites regression-prone

realpath() and abspath() variants in reads.py and compact/fsck utilities require per-site design decisions to determine whether they should resolve to the code repo root (requiring signature changes to thread repo_root through read-path helpers) or legitimately read from the store's own git repository

Relocated stores (REBAR_TRACKER_DIR outside the code repo) are a supported feature with an existing contract, yet three sites compose the config root incorrectly from the store path rather than threading the already-in-scope repo_root parameter

The fixed str()-variant sites require threading repo_root into _edit_description_warning and replacing dirname(str(tracker)) with str(config.repo_root(repo_root)) to preserve behavior on relocated stores
